## Rate, periods and amount {#fm4-finish .fm-slide }

Use the rate **per compounding period**.

Count the **matching periods**.

Subtract the principal when asked for **interest earned**.

::: {.takeaway}
I can match the rate and number of periods to calculate a final balance and interest earned.
:::

::: notes
Exit check: “For 4 years of monthly compounding, what is n?” Answer 48. Ask one student to distinguish r=5/12 in the percentage-rate formula from the decimal 0.05/12.
:::
